charterSection: Release B — passing yards, baseline first
why: On the population-contract evaluation the share-volume baseline beats the simulation chain on passing MAE (70.35 vs 80.67 over played candidates; 61.8 vs 74.7 starter-conditioned in the P247 diagnosis). The charter's rule: a supported simple baseline is preferable to an unsupported complex model. The baseline is therefore THE candidate — promoted only if its own DISTRIBUTION clears the family bars; a lower point error alone earns nothing.

candidate.population: population contract v2; conditional-on-played (DID_NOT_DRESS voids; ambiguous/source-missing excluded and counted). Stated as model-only conditioning, never a sportsbook-settled record.
candidate.center: mu = qbShare_wf x (volume.pass.a0 + volume.pass.a1 x E[ownMargin]) x league.compRate x league.ypcmp — every input forecast-time (walk-forward share, committed train constants, margin mean from the committed game-sim heads). No realized-boxscore starter inference.
candidate.distribution: Nonparametric TRAIN residual quantiles, fitted on 2023-24 walk-forward residuals (actual - mu) POOLED WITHIN THREE SHARE BUCKETS frozen in advance: share >= 0.7 (clear starter), 0.2-0.7 (contested), < 0.2 (reserve). Predictive quantiles = mu + bucket residual quantile, floored at 0. Threshold probabilities from the bucket's empirical residual CDF. No parameter is fit on 2025.
candidate.whatIsNotAllowed: No 2025 fitting or selection; no starter inference from the scored game's boxscore; no interval widening chosen after seeing 2025 coverage; no change to any other family.

protocol.fit: 2023-24 REG+POST walk-forward residual collection under the identical population contract
protocol.test: held-out 2025 scored once beside the champion simulation chain and the rolling4 baseline on identical points

frozenBars.sameGatesAsEveryFamily: beats rolling4 AND (for this candidate, the sim-chain champion) on MAE on identical points; coverage80 in [0.72, 0.88]; ece <= 0.05; n >= 300
frozenBars.note: the shareVol point baseline is the candidate's own center, so 'beats shareVol' is replaced by 'beats the current champion chain' — the comparison that decides which engine backs the family

decisionRule: ALL bars pass -> pass-yds-baseline-v1 becomes the family's engine: the runtime publishes its distribution for the projected starter with conditional-on-playing labeling, promotion recorded receipt-first, boards publish through the standard gates. ANY bar fails -> REJECTED with the numbers; the family stays withheld and the next dependency is named from the residual evidence.
evidentiaryStatus: 2025 reused (P247 annex; its residual structure motivated this candidate). 2026 forward record decides.
notes: Registered before implementation; commit order is the proof.
